The '''14th Producers Guild of America Awards''' (also known as '''2003 Producers Guild Awards'''), honoring the best [[Film producer|film]] and [[television producer]]s of 2002, were held at [[The Century Plaza Hotel]] in [[Los Angeles, California]] on March 2, 2003.<ref>{{cite news |last1=McNary |first1=Dave |title=Producers join 'Chicago' chorus |url=https://variety.com/2003/tv/awards/producers-join-chicago-chorus-1117881524/ |accessdate=April 10, 2020 |work=Variety |date=March 2, 2003 |archive-date=April 10, 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200410165953/https://variety.com/2003/tv/awards/producers-join-chicago-chorus-1117881524/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Another award for 'Chicago'|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-2003-mar-04-et-quick4.1-story.html|access-date=September 21, 2017|work=Los Angeles Times|date=March 4, 2003|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170923130823/http://articles.latimes.com/2003/mar/04/entertainment/et-quick4.1|archive-date=September 23, 2017|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Producers Guild Awards 2003 |url=http://www.producersguild.org/pg/awards_a/awards2003win.asp |publisher=Producers Guild of America |accessdate=April 10, 2020 |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20041211103659/http://www.producersguild.org/pg/awards_a/awards2003win.asp |archivedate=December 11, 2004 |url-status=dead}}</ref> The ceremony was hosted by [[Patricia Heaton]]. The nominees were announced on January 16, 2003.<ref>{{cite news|last1=McNary|first1=Dave|title=Big pix click with PGA|url=https://variety.com/2003/film/features/big-pix-click-with-pga-1117878879/|accessdate=September 22, 2017|work=Variety|date=January 16, 2003|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20170923130934/http://variety.com/2003/film/features/big-pix-click-with-pga-1117878879/|archivedate=September 23, 2017|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Producers Guild nominates ''Chicago,'' ''Sopranos''|url=http://ew.com/article/2003/01/17/producers-guild-nominates-chicago-sopranos/|website=EW.com|accessdate=August 27, 2017|date=January 17, 2003|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20170516181700/http://ew.com/article/2003/01/17/producers-guild-nominates-chicago-sopranos/|archivedate=May 16, 2017|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Miramax has two contenders up for Producers Guild award|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-2003-jan-18-et-guild18-story.html|access-date=September 21, 2017|work=Los Angeles Times|date=January 18, 2003|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160402165659/http://articles.latimes.com/2003/jan/18/entertainment/et-guild18|archive-date=April 2, 2016|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=PGA Award Winners 1990-2010 - Producers Guild of America|url=http://www.producersguild.org/page/PGA_Award_19902010|website=www.producersguild.org|access-date=August 27, 2017  |archive-date= November 27, 2020 |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20201127023852/http://www.producersguild.org/page/PGA_Award_19902010 |url-status=dead}}</ref>
